column2: Why is the right lung generally shorter and wider than the left?

column2: How does the relation of bronchus and pulmonary artery at the hilum differ between right and left?

column2: How does the silhouette sign localise an opacity on a frontal radiograph?
column3: Right heart border abuts right middle lobe, left heart border the lingula, and diaphragms the lower lobes, so loss of a border places the air-space opacity in the adjacent lobe.
